notes: WHAT'S NEW IN 4.2.1: (1) TUNEHIVE GREEN IS THE ONE UI — the olive-green/lime TuneHive design is now the app's only interface (no UI Styles picker, no second UI): olive background, lime accent, circular player art with a lime progress ring + knob, lime Home button, lime splash + update sheet + floating Island, one-time 'Start Your Sonic Journey' welcome on first launch. (2) UPDATE SCREEN REDESIGNED in the same green UI — the in-app update sheet (available → downloading with live progress → ready to install) is olive/lime with the vibe logo and lime Install button. (3) TAREEFAN FIX — the full song WAS found (Saavn 320kbps + YouTube itag 140 verified live) but failed to LOAD; the old handler only fell back YouTube → Saavn, so a Saavn win dropped straight to the 30s preview and wrongly said 'no full version found'. Now the fallback is symmetric (Saavn ↔ YouTube, plus the phone-side race when a backend stream fails), each source tried once, and the label is honest. Kept from 4.2.0: cyberxapi YouTube search (primary), vibe logo, MP3 only, Google sign-in, audio-output indicator (Phone speaker / Bluetooth · name). NOTE for 4.1.5 users: the in-app download can stick at 0% on 4.1.5 — if it does, tap Cancel and install the APK file sent in chat, it updates the same app.
